mapper.select: SELECT pep.patient_id AS patientId, p.name AS patientName, p.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, p.birth_date AS birthDate, p.medical_record_no AS medicalRecordNo, p.disease_type AS diseaseType, p.id_card AS idCard, pd.diagnosis AS diagnosis, p.enrollment_institution AS enrollmentInstitution, pep.id AS prescriptionId, pep.medical_scheme_id AS schemeId, pep.prescription_name AS prescriptionName, pep.execution_institution AS executionInstitution, pep.prescription_status AS prescriptionStatus, pep.prescribing_doctor AS prescribingDoctor, pep.created_time AS createdTime FROM patient_exercise_prescription pep LEFT JOIN patient p ON pep.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN patient_detail pd ON pd.patient_id = p.id WHERE pep.id = #{prescriptionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, exercise_scene, exercise_type, exercise_method, precautions, duration_minutes, exercise_frequency, exercise_intensity, cycle_weeks, total_sessions, weekly_total_minutes, progression, remarks, exercise_image FROM patient_prescribed_exercise WHERE exercise_prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE patient_prescribed_exercise SET execution_institution = #{executionInstitution}, prescription_status = #{prescriptionStatus}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE exercise_prescription_id = #{prescriptionId}
